head: 716b2b88
behavior: The Hysteria v3 server now runs on quic.endpoint_server.Server. One pump owns the UDP socket and all connections; destination connects run on bounded workers; TCP relays use bounded queues and short partial-write turns; UDP associations are created from request streams and replies use QUIC DATAGRAM frames. The integration test covers the control hello, two concurrent TCP relays, and a UDP echo through the datagram relay.
conclusion: The Hysteria v3 receive-owner blocker is resolved. No independent Hysteria v3 peer is available in the current toolchain, so verification remains an in-repo client/server integration test.
